answer: Staked growth reserves let an identity earn more of its asset by joining a spiral of reputation gains from multiple parties, each returning gains to the shared pool. The rule is that only reserved capital unlocked by those gains can fund fresh claims, so an attacker must grow the pool with real verified spend before it can raise stakes. Each new identity pays 1,000 tokens of opportunity cost plus the nectar it forgoes by tying capital to a nebula of incremental returns.
